acceptedFindings.invariant: Only a successful non-null structured Recipe page can establish known absence.
acceptedFindings.analysis: The published boundaries reject failed Loaded results before RecipeExperience. A successful null bypasses its page branch. RecipeContent defaults nutritionKnown=false, so stateOf(null)/emptyRecipe and all existing editor/direct callers retain unknown nutrition. Only the non-null page branch passes the opt-in.

acceptedFindings.invariant: Nutrient presence is never described as absence.
acceptedFindings.analysis: The predicate examines kind=nutrient, not array length or numeric truthiness. Non-nutrient measures allow the absence text; one nutrient of any value, coverage or basis suppresses it.

acceptedFindings.invariant: The added state has a useful, accessible and localized meaning.
acceptedFindings.analysis: The Nutrition heading plus Nutrition not provided distinguishes absent supplied information from a failed read and from a zero nutrient value. section aria-labelledby points to a useId heading. English and all seven locale catalogs gain exactly the two keys through the existing catalog contract. Machine-draft annotations remain explicit.

acceptedFindings.invariant: Source data and existing experience behavior are preserved.
acceptedFindings.analysis: No measure/value transformation, health inference, synthetic declared servings, author relation, backend scaling or read mutation is introduced. Facts, ingredient quantities/lines, instructions, notes, controls, editor and published callers preserve parent behavior; the passing isolated ingredient/method assertions and viewed yield output corroborate the bounded presentation.
